# LIBERO simulation deps (Linux only; requires sys_platform == 'linux')
# Self-contained: includes base requirements so callers only need this one file.
#
# We drive libero.libero.envs.OffScreenRenderEnv directly and no longer use
# LeRobot's env factory, but the `lerobot[libero]` extra is what installs the
# `libero` package (plus a robosuite/mujoco resolution known to work headless),
# so it stays. Slimming this to a direct LIBERO pin is an optional follow-up.
#
# Headless rendering needs: export MUJOCO_GL=egl PYOPENGL_PLATFORM=egl
-r requirements.txt
lerobot[libero]>=0.5
